scripts.dev:all: npm run build -w @nmm/shared && concurrently -n web,api "npm run dev -w @nmm/web-client" "npm run dev:api"
scripts.dev:web: npm run build -w @nmm/shared && npm run dev -w @nmm/web-client
scripts.estate:embeddings:sync: docker compose --env-file ${NMM_ENV_FILE:-apps/api-server/.env} run --rm api-server npm run estate:embeddings:sync -w @nmm/api-server --
scripts.preview:web: npm run build -w @nmm/shared && npm run build:profile -w @nmm/web-client && npm run preview -w @nmm/web-client
scripts.build: npm run build -w @nmm/shared && npm run build -w @nmm/web-client && npm run build -w @nmm/api-server && npm run build -w @nmm/mcp-server
scripts.build:web: npm run build -w @nmm/shared && npm run build -w @nmm/web-client
scripts.build:api: npm run build -w @nmm/shared && npm run build -w @nmm/api-server
scripts.build:mcp: npm run build -w @nmm/shared && npm run build -w @nmm/mcp-server
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @nmm/shared && npm run build -w @nmm/shared && npm run typecheck -w @nmm/ui && npm run typecheck -w @nmm/web-client && npm run typecheck -w @nmm/api-server && npm run typecheck -w @nmm/mcp-server
scripts.typecheck:mcp: npm run build -w @nmm/shared && npm run typecheck -w @nmm/mcp-server
scripts.verify: npm run lint && npm run format:check && npm run typecheck && npm run build
